items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Dick had asked Klney, the lady that runs the fair

ctx.x: I believe that's his name. I believe he was. Yeah, that's his name, Chuck Delmonico. But I can only play, you know, that Friday night, because the Saturday was my day and Dick had planned to go because at first, Dick had asked Klney, the lady that runs the fair, she says

-- he asked her, says, "Now, are you sure you only want one night? Because the guys, they have to know now." He said, "Because you can't wait until the last minute and decide you want them to play that next night." So she says, "No, one night's all right." So in the middle of the stream at his party, she decides she wants them to stay two nights, you know. And they all had planned to go with me on my day. But he couldn't go because he had to be there with them. They had to play like from five to seven that…
